mapper.insert: INSERT INTO observation (report_id, original_name, original_value, result_kind, numeric_value, unit_text, reference_text, reference_low, reference_high, abnormal_flag, examination_date, confidence, confirmed_at, source_photo_id, status, row_order, created_at, updated_at, supersedes_id, created_revision_id) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{originalName}, #{originalValue}, #{resultKind}, #{numericValue}, #{unitText}, #{referenceText}, #{referenceLow}, #{referenceHigh}, #{abnormalFlag}, #{examinationDate}, #{confidence}, #{confirmedAt}, #{sourcePhotoId}, #{status}, #{rowOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{supersedesId}, #{createdRevisionId})
mapper.sql: id, report_id, original_name, original_value, result_kind, numeric_value, unit_text, reference_text, reference_low, reference_high, abnormal_flag, examination_date, confidence, confirmed_at, source_photo_id, status, row_order, created_at, updated_at, supersedes_id, created_revision_id, retired_revision_id, retired_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM observation WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY row_order, id
SELECT FROM observation WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(row_order), -1) FROM observation WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE observation SET original_name = #{originalName}, original_value = #{originalValue}, result_kind = #{resultKind}, numeric_value = #{numericValue}, unit_text = #{unitText}, reference_text = #{referenceText}, reference_low = #{referenceLow}, reference_high = #{referenceHigh}, abnormal_flag = #{abnormalFlag}, confidence = #{confidence}, row_order = #{rowOrder}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM observation WHERE id = #{id} AND report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
DELETE FROM observation WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.update: UPDATE observation SET status = 'FORMAL', examination_date = #{examinationDate}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, updated_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE observation o JOIN metric_alias a ON a.alias_normalized = UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(o.original_name), ' ', ''), ' ', ''), '％', '%')) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin SET o.metric_definition_id = a.metric_definition_id WHERE o.report_id = #{reportId} AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.temp_metric_id IS NULL AND (a.required_unit IS NULL OR REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(IFNULL(o.unit_text, '')), ' ', ''), '％', '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_bin = a.required_unit)
UPDATE observation SET supersedes_id = NULL WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND supersedes_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE observation SET status = #{status}, retired_revision_id = #{revisionId}, retired_at = #{retiredAt}, updated_at = #{retiredAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'FORMAL'
